newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse pursues upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse pursues upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca stock market closed on Thursday 0.22 percent higher with trading in small volumes inflating the prices, a stockbroker said.
The all-share index closed at 527.53 points from 526.38 on Wednesday.
"I think the index will keep that trend, the publication of annual results will then determine its course," a broker at Casablanca-based Maroc Services Intermediation said.
In the agro-industry sector dairy firm Centrale Laitiere was up 64 dirhams to 2217 dirhams.
ONA group and Societe Nationale d'investissement, the two biggest holdings, were up respectively 10 and three dirhams to close at 660 and 608 dirhams.
Brasseries du Maroc dipped 35 dirhams to 2,000 dirhams. The firm is to expand after it purchased recently 80 percent of soft drinks firm Societe Industrielle Marocaine (SIM) for $52 million).
In the banking sector, Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l'Industrie remained unchanged at 428 dirhams.
Credit firm Credor which was floated on the bourse in December last year, fell 15 dirhams to 605 dirhams.
Oil refinery Samir shed eight dirhams to close at 270 dirhams after one-week steady gains.
Steel mill Sonasid jumped 17 dirhams to 440 dirhams.
"We expect the firm to have good annual results," he said.
Traded volume on the official market was 37.5 million dirhams 65.2 million the previous session.
